finding: 239 WordPress Media Attachment pages indexed in sitemap.xml (79.9% index bloat)
fix: In All in One SEO -> Search Appearance -> Media: set Redirect Attachment URLs to 'Attachment Parent' and exclude Media from XML sitemap.

finding: 237 indexable URLs with missing meta descriptions (6 real pages/posts + 239 attachment pages)
fix: Write 140-158 char metas on /junction-industries-news/, /privacy-policy/, and all 4 news articles; 3 remaining core pages (/companies/, /about-junction-industries/, /join-us/) exceed 160 chars and truncate.

finding: 4 core commercial pages have zero <h1> tags (Companies, About, Contact, Join Us)
fix: Change top hero Divi Text/Heading module from H2 to H1 on /companies/, /about-junction-industries/, /contact-us/, and /join-us/. Fix H2-before-H1 order on Homepage.

finding: Zero server page caching (Cache-Control: no-cache, max-age=0; Expires: 1984) & slow mobile LCP / TTFB (1.25s-2.45s)
fix: Enable full-page caching + Cloudflare edge caching; preload hero background images; remove unused Divi CSS/JS.

finding: Viewport meta tag disables user pinch-to-zoom (maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=0) on all 299 URLs
fix: Remove Divi custom viewport override so <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1'> is served.

finding: 2-hop non-www HTTP redirect chain (2,339ms) + 0/5 HTTP security headers (missing HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy)
fix: Consolidate http://jct-ind.com/* directly to https://www.jct-ind.com/$1 in a single 301 hop and add security response headers in .htaccess / Cloudflare.

finding: 89 images missing alt text across 9 of 11 real pages (325 total across sitemap)
fix: Add descriptive alt attributes to all 46 portfolio company logos/project photos on /companies/, 8 images on /, and 7 on /contact-us/. Add width/height to hero logo on /join-us/.

finding: Generic Organization schema missing Fort Worth TX address, phone, Founding/Veteran-Owned credentials, and 10 subsidiary subOrganization entities
fix: Inject enriched Organization / Corporation + subOrganization JSON-LD (see Schema tab) and add named executive bios + Fort Worth HQ address to About/Contact.

finding: Zero Open Graph (og:*) and Twitter Card meta tags across all 11 core pages
fix: Enable Open Graph & Twitter Card markup in All in One SEO -> Social Networks and set a default 1200x630 share image.

finding: /llms.txt has UTF-8 BOM + plugin advertisement header, lacks '>' summary, and leaks /seedprod/sp-cs/ & /category/uncategorized/
fix: Replace auto-generated AIOSEO /llms.txt with curated entity-rich markdown file (see Robots & llms.txt tab) and add explicit AI crawler Allow rules.

finding: 15 weak/short titles (<25 chars or raw camera filenames) & 12 titles over 65 characters
fix: Append '| Junction Industries' brand suffix to short titles (/junction-industries-news/, /privacy-policy/, /pier-57-coming-soon/) and trim 72-char acquisition post title.

finding: No dedicated subsidiary or capability landing pages (all 10 operating companies sit on a single /companies/ page with outbound-only links)
fix: Create internal hub pages for EPC & Industrial Construction, Intralogistics & Material Handling, and Technology Services, plus individual subsidiary profiles.
